metadata.title: User Registration with Email and Password

story.iWant: to create an account using my email address and a password
story.soThat: I can establish a unique identity and prepare to access personalized features of the application.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create the registration UI form using Shadcn UI components (Input, Button, Label). (AC: 1) - Task 2: Implement client-side validation for email format and matching passwords, triggering onBlur. (AC: 1) - Task 3: Create an `AuthManager` service that encapsulates the Supabase client. (AC: 2) - Task 4: Implement the `signUp` method in `AuthManager` to call `supabase.auth.signUp()`. (AC: 2, 3) - Task 5: Connect the UI form's "Sign Up" button to the `AuthManager.signUp` method. (AC: 2) - Task 6: Display a success toast notification upon successful registration API response. (AC: 4) - Task 7: Write a unit test for the `AuthManager.signUp` method, mocking the supabase client. - Task 8: Write a component test for the registration form to verify validation and submission.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I am on the registration page, Then the page must display a form containing fields for "Email," "Password," and "Confirm Password," along with a "Sign Up" button. - AC 2: Given I have filled the form with a valid, unused email and matching passwords, When I click the "Sign Up" button, Then the client-side `AuthManager.signUp` function is invoked with the provided credentials. - AC 3: Given the `signUp` function is called successfully, When Supabase processes the request, Then it must send a verification email to the address provided by the user. - AC 4: Given the registration request was submitted successfully, When the UI updates, Then a clear message must be displayed on the screen instructing the user to check their email to complete the registration process. - AC 5: Given a successful registration, When inspecting the backend, Then a new record corresponding to the user must exist in the `auth.users` table, and its `confirmed_at` field must be null.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: Interaction will be primarily with the `supabase-js` client library. The `AuthManager` module will expose methods that wrap these calls.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: New User Registration: User fills out and submits the registration form in the Next.js app. The `AuthManager` calls `supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })`. Supabase creates the user in the `auth.users` table (with `confirmed_at` as null) and sends a verification email.

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: The `public.users` table stores user information and is linked to `auth.users` via a `UUID` primary key that is a foreign key to `auth.users(id)`. Row Level Security is enabled.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Forms will use "floating labels." The label will appear inside the input field as a placeholder and will animate to a position above the field when the user focuses on it. Form field validation will be triggered `onBlur`.

story-context.constraints: - All authentication logic must be managed by Supabase Auth. - User sessions will be managed via JWTs issued by Supabase. - Client-side authentication logic must be wrapped in an `AuthManager` service. - All UI components must be from the Shadcn UI library. - Form validation must trigger onBlur. - Success feedback should use non-intrusive toast notifications.

interface.name: IAuthManager

tests.standards: Use a testing framework like Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests. Create unit tests for services like AuthManager, mocking external calls. Test UI components in isolation.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC1, 2) Integration test of the registration form submission. - (AC2) Unit test the `AuthManager.signUp` method to ensure it calls the Supabase client correctly. - (AC3) E2E test: register and check for a (mocked) verification email. - (AC5) Write a database test to confirm a new user is created in `auth.users` with a null `confirmed_at` value after signup.
